trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks automatically. There is no online requirement and no DLC needed — everything is in the single-player game. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full road to platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unlocked automatically. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first main mission of the game. Nothing to prepare; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1; it unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2; it unlocks as Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4; it unlocks after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the game. Guides disagree on the final mission's name, so follow the story to its end rather than hunting a named mission — it unlocks automatically when the story concludes. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion, tracked under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (visible after the story; progress made during the story already counts). The list is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests aren't required, and of the required collectibles you typically need only 70–80%. The hard numbers: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable — everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You may mix categories, and Under the Bridges runs are the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. Most come naturally from the story and other trophies, so this usually unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. Learn each challenge's par time and accuracy target, and retry the ones you miss — gold medals are needed, not just completion. PowerPyx maps all 12 range locations and the 42 gold-medal requirements.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 drone race locations (42 races in total). Each location counts once you win any race there; tight cornering matters more than raw speed. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins at the same spot. Races include car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races; PowerPyx maps all 40 unique race locations. Work through them while doing the drone-race and stunt trophies.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and win the fishing challenge against him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home (interact with the controllers), from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of one game once is enough — you don't need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline (Lucia only) starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her Belville address. Finish all 5 Andy quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — all still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams; he calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. Clear 7 shipwrecks for him: he marks purple treasure-chest icons, you dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish all 5 Billy quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — all available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Four strands are confirmed: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street races and mentoring), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries). More stranger strands exist but are still being confirmed — check the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see your count. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the ones he marks are easiest, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with WAiNK to check if it's on his list. Deliveries in good condition pay more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline (Jason only) starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go in and destroy them (quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. Meditating with both Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts +2. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only available during Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she wants to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. It raises your meditation counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline (Jason only) starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Meet Bret, then follow his marked hunting spots (purple icons) and bring him the animals he requests; he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest. It is still unconfirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy — work through all 15 Target Decks (needed for 100% anyway) and it will come. Track them under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets hidden across Leonida; completing any 3 full sets unlocks the trophy. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations — pick the three sets whose cards are closest together and collect every card in each set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up + R1 to scan scannable objects in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. There are far more than 100, so any 100 count; scan whatever you pass while doing other trophies and this finishes on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this unlocks on the way there. Track challenges under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark at bottom right shows completed ones) and pick the easiest remaining ones — 10 more than needed are available, so skip the hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. First available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Build 4 stars, then escape in a fast sports bike, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you. The trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone. You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which forces 4-star escapes.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. After Coffee Break, call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it doesn't, hit a 4th. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3): loot a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and don't leave the first store before police arrive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan vehicles with R1 — you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; the game has 557 vehicles at launch. You need 200 of 277 base models scanned for 100%, so this comes automatically. Track totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (eat/drink, wash your face or shower at home, consume Adrenaline to extend it), wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies at a gang operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); level it up via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus Level 4 this is much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Get in a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick — never kick the door), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after leaving. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it marks itself from story progress): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag (hold Right to hand one off). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (purple icons) — you must first have robbed 2 Payday Loans for him. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Only 5 are needed for the trophy, but all 8 are needed for 100%, paying up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is…: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts. You can also do it earlier — block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. PowerPyx's unfogging guide names the best plane for the job.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total (yellow map icons when nearby); one per gang is enough for the trophy, but all 39 are needed for 100%. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only this specific blue Banshee counts (a GTA III easter egg); the trophy pops a moment after you drive away.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation) and steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab what's left — it isn't missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch characters. Buy a fitness-club membership, always work out together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner — while one trains, the other progresses too), and filter for gyms on Map > Activities. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes count as Professional; incapacitating enemies counts as Hardened; killing counts as Violent; mass cop/civilian kills count as Psycho. It accrues passively through every other trophy — if you're short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car (but beware: at Psycho or Irredeemable, cops shoot on sight).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — this trophy's unlock is still unknown. The leading suspicion is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (in Little Cuba, Vice City), possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner — 'second time's the charm'. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; check the cited sources for updates before attempting it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it's not there, drive away and come back until it spawns (it's slightly random, not guaranteed). Follow the path from the car into the woods to find the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it, and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are dense.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies; bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while doing robberies for 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Shops include 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores, 14 mod shops and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages (4 story garages don't count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages unlock for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Fund it with robberies, which pay much better in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register in his garage. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
